name: Arunachal: Ziro, Mechuka, Anini and Walong
one_line: Central and eastern Arunachal Pradesh: Ziro and Mechuka, then the Dibang valley to Anini and the Lohit valley to Walong

source.title: Arunachal Pradesh Bike Trip: Mechuka, Anini & Walong Travel Guide

usual_season.value: Late October to early November, and April to May

source.title: Arunachal Pradesh Bike Trip: Mechuka, Anini & Walong Travel Guide

fuel.note: Pumps are those drawn on the open map within the search radius of the road. A pump missing from the map is missing here, so each gap is a worst case.

rules.title: Arunachal Pradesh: Inner Line Permit for Indian citizens
rules.detail: Applied for online. The tourist permit allows a stay of up to 14 days. The official page lists 300 rupees up to three days and 500 rupees up to 14.
rules.applies_to: Indian citizens from outside Arunachal Pradesh

source.title: Tourist electronic Inner Line Permit: application page

history.change: New online permit portal launched across the state.

source.title: Arunachal Pradesh electronic Inner Line Permit portal

rules.title: Arunachal Pradesh: permit counters outside the portal
rules.detail: A Tawang advisory names issuing offices at Delhi, Kolkata, Guwahati, Tezpur and Bhalukpong. West Kameng district also issues it at the Deputy Commissioner's office in Bomdila.
rules.applies_to: Indian citizens from outside Arunachal Pradesh

source.title: Advisory, Office of the District Tourism Officer, Tawang

rules.title: Arunachal Pradesh: extra permission near the border, per guide
rules.detail: A 2025 rider guide says army check posts beyond Mechuka want prior permission from the district authority, which homestays help arrange. No official page found.
rules.set_by: Not established; reported by a guide

source.title: Arunachal Pradesh Bike Trip: Mechuka, Anini & Walong Travel Guide

rules.title: Arunachal Pradesh: foreign citizens need a Protected Area Permit
rules.detail: The state permit portal is for Indian citizens only and sends foreign citizens to the Foreigners Regional Registration Office portal. Group size, validity and fee not found officially.
rules.set_by: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India

source.title: Tourist electronic Inner Line Permit: application page

season.note: No road on this route has an announced seasonal closure; Mayodia Pass gets snow from November to March and the monsoon closes roads by landslide.

authorities.office: Department of Information Technology and Communication, Government of Arunachal Pradesh
authorities.announces: Runs the online Inner Line Permit portal

source.title: Arunachal Pradesh electronic Inner Line Permit portal

authorities.office: National Highways and Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited
authorities.announces: Maintains National Highway 313 through a contractor; clears landslides
Widens and restores the road to Mechuka

source.title: BRO to complete strategically vital road by March 2026: CE

hazards.title: Landslides on the Roing to Anini highway
hazards.detail: In March 2025 slides hit several points for two weeks, including Angolin, Kano and Akobe. Each block took six hours to a day to clear.

hazards.title: Landslides and road works between Tato and Mechuka
hazards.detail: A slide near Shene Nallah shut the road in August 2025; it was cleared within a day. Widening between Pene and Tato was due by March 2026.

source.title: Arunachal: BRO Restores Tato-Menchuka Road in Shi-Yomi Within 24 Hours After Massive Landslide

hazards.title: Snow at Mayodia Pass
hazards.detail: The pass between Roing and Anini gets snow from November to March, heaviest in January and February.

hazards.title: Fuel pumps are rare
hazards.detail: A rider guide warns never to run down to reserve; some villages sell petrol informally at a higher price.

source.title: Arunachal Pradesh Bike Trip: Mechuka, Anini & Walong Travel Guide

hazards.title: Rockfall and narrow tracks
hazards.detail: The same guide reports loose stones, sudden rockfall and narrow muddy tracks, with 180 to 200 kilometres taking six to seven hours.

source.title: Arunachal Pradesh Bike Trip: Mechuka, Anini & Walong Travel Guide

gaps: No official source found for any permit beyond the Inner Line Permit for Mechuka, Anini, Walong or Kibithoo; the claim comes from one guide.
Highway numbers for the Aalo to Mechuka road and the Tezu to Walong road not sourced.
Highest point is given as Mayodia Pass; a guide mentions a higher army post beyond Mechuka, which is off this route and unverified.
No official road status page found for Arunachal Pradesh; blockages surface only through regional news.
A February 2025 washout near Anini is known from a search result only and was not opened.
No dated source found for road conditions on the Ziro to Daporijo stretch or the Tezu to Walong stretch.
Whether the Pene to Tato widening met its March 2026 target was not checked.
Protected Area Permit details for foreign citizens not found on an official page.
